method: In-tree build script reproduces the three deployed shared objects byte for byte; configuration, dynamic metadata and on-board handshakes reviewed

details.license_choice: Mbed TLS is dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later; this build is distributed under Apache-2.0 and no GPL-only component is linked
details.build: make -C library SHARED=1 CC=arm-uclinuxfdpiceabi-gcc CFLAGS='-Os -g0 -I<build> -DMBEDTLS_CONFIG_FILE="mbedtls-config.h"' WARNING_CFLAGS=; stripped with arm-uclinuxfdpiceabi-strip
details.configuration: sdk-src/configs/mbedtls-config.h: TLS 1.2/1.3 client only, ECDHE/DHE-RSA/ECDSA and RSA key exchange, AES-GCM/CCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, X25519 and P-256/384/521, SHA-1/SHA-2, MBEDTLS_FS_IO (curl parses CA files from disk), MBEDTLS_PSA_CRYPTO_C (required by TLS 1.3 in 3.6), MBEDTLS_DEBUG_C. Server mode, DTLS, PSK/ECJPAKE, legacy ciphers and the persistent PSA key store are disabled; MBEDTLS_ECDSA_DETERMINISTIC is left off because it fails check_config without further prerequisites
details.shared_not_static: Built as the three shared objects so every TLS client on the board links one copy; curl is currently the only user
details.reproduction: make mbedtls run twice from the published script; all three objects identical both times (207376 + 28640 + 119212 bytes stripped)
details.dynamic_metadata: FDPIC shared objects, no TEXTREL, SONAMEs libmbedtls.so.21 / libmbedx509.so.7 / libmbedcrypto.so.16
details.on_board: Verified on the N32H787 board: curl completes a TLS 1.3 handshake negotiated as TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256 against public servers
details.licenses: Apache-2.0; LICENSE preserved in licenses/mbedtls/LICENSE and installed in the rootfs
